Why am I not doing enough damage?
Make sure you play the build & rotation correctly and apply important debuffs such as

Due to the multiplicative scaling of builds in Diablo 4, even small differences in average item quality, glyph levels, legendary/unique affixes etc. can stack up to massive differences in total output.

Make sure to focus on high rolls of impactful stats such as damage multipliers on gear (Vulnerable multi/Crit multi /DoT multi/All + Elemental multi where applicable). If you are playing a Crit-based build, also make sure to check your Crit Chance.
Level your glyphs as high as you comfortably can in speedruns, then boost them further by pushing as high as possible once you have gathered your endgame gear.
Reroll values of impactful uniques/charms with large multipliers in the cube until they are (near) perfect.
Farm more XP/Paragons if you are still below 250, ideally closer to 280 to get most of the useful nodes on all boards.

In the lategame, transfigurations make a major difference (usually ~x2-x3 dmg from this is relatively achievable by stacking up Main Stat/All Stats and a few good outcomes such as Elemental Multi/Crit Chance/Attack Speed/Skill Ranks across all item slots). This requires to refarm some items if you brick them or get bad outcomes.
Ramp up your defensive stats: Maximum Life, Armor, Resistances
Make sure that none of your individual resistance types are too low (add gem/temper/charm/enchant)
Aim for GA Life rolls and masterwork them on your weapons
Pick defensive Paragon nodes before offensive/scaling glyph effects
Pay attention to the most dangerous effects and potentially swap your jewelry gems to focus on specific resistance types (generally Fire, Lightning and Poison are the most dangerous)
How do I activate the doubled Paragon rare node bonuses?

Some Paragon nodes (especially on later boards) are not going to be activated. The Paragon setup is optimized to account for that and it's not worth to focus on stacking more stats to gain these minuscule effects.

However, 1-2 "All Stats" transfigurations or 1-2 Diamonds in armor pieces may activate a few nodes at once, making such a swap impactful enough even if the value of All Stats is generally small by itself.
